list.item: Type 2 diabetes with hyperglycemia, about twelve years' duration, A1c 8.4% on metformin; synthetic modern episode linked to his publicly reported diabetes: active, confirmed [S]
Hypertension above goal on lisinopril (152/92 mmHg in the clinic); synthetic modern episode linked to his publicly reported high blood pressure: active, confirmed [S]
Raised AST (48 U/L) with mildly low platelets (138) and a FIB-4 score of 3.43 at the yearly liver check, to be evaluated: active, confirmed [S]
Hyperlipidemia: LDL 132 mg/dL, HDL 38 and triglycerides 210, not on a statin: active, confirmed [S]
Reduced vision in the left eye since a cataract found at 20 (counting fingers at 1 meter); right eye 20/30: active, confirmed [S]

Diabetes: continue metformin, an A1c every three months until at goal and then every six months, diabetes self-management education, a vitamin B12 check on long-term metformin, and no medicine that causes low blood sugar. Guideline: 9. Pharmacologic Approaches to Glycemic Treatment: Standards of Care in Diabetes-2026 (2026); CMID: Clinical Monitoring Intelligence Database, diabetes type 2, hypertension and hyperlipidemia monographs (2026) [S]

Hepatology consultation for a high FIB-4 with mildly low platelets, with transient elastography and a liver ultrasound the same day. Guideline: 4. Comprehensive Medical Evaluation and Assessment of Comorbidities: Standards of Care in Diabetes-2026 (2026); AASLD Practice Guidance on the clinical assessment and management of nonalcoholic fatty liver disease (now metabolic dysfunction-associated steatotic liver disease) (2023) [S]

Liver assessment: FIB-4 from the yearly liver tests, then transient elastography if FIB-4 is 1.3 or higher; hepatitis B, hepatitis C and HIV tests, iron studies, and an alcohol history. Guideline: 4. Comprehensive Medical Evaluation and Assessment of Comorbidities: Standards of Care in Diabetes-2026 (2026); AASLD Practice Guidance on the clinical assessment and management of nonalcoholic fatty liver disease (now metabolic dysfunction-associated steatotic liver disease) (2023); CMID: Clinical Monitoring Intelligence Database, diabetes type 2, hypertension and hyperlipidemia monographs (2026) [S]

Blood pressure: a validated home monitor with a large cuff, readings twice a day for a week, a goal below 130/80 mmHg, and less salt. Guideline: 2025 AHA/ACC/AANP/AAPA/ABC/ACCP/ACPM/AGS/AMA/ASPC/NMA/PCNA/SGIM Guideline for the Prevention, Detection, Evaluation, and Management of High Blood Pressure in Adults (2025); CMID: Clinical Monitoring Intelligence Database, diabetes type 2, hypertension and hyperlipidemia monographs (2026) [S]

Cardiovascular risk: atorvastatin 40 mg with a lipid panel at four to twelve weeks; a baseline ECG; aspirin for primary prevention not used because of bleeding risk. Guideline: 10. Cardiovascular Disease and Risk Management: Standards of Care in Diabetes-2026 (2026); CMID: Clinical Monitoring Intelligence Database, diabetes type 2, hypertension and hyperlipidemia monographs (2026) [S]

Kidneys: eGFR by the race-free CKD-EPI 2003 equation and urine albumin-to-creatinine ratio at least yearly, and potassium and creatinine on lisinopril. Guideline: 11. Chronic Kidney Disease and Risk Management: Standards of Care in Diabetes-2026 (2026); CMID: Clinical Monitoring Intelligence Database, diabetes type 2, hypertension and hyperlipidemia monographs (2026) [S]

Eyes and feet: a dilated eye examination at the eye clinic, a comprehensive foot examination yearly, daily foot checks and callus care. Guideline: 12. Retinopathy, Neuropathy, and Foot Care: Standards of Care in Diabetes-2026 (2026) [S]

Brain health: a documented cognitive screen at the preventive visit, blood pressure and glucose control, sleep, hearing and mood checks, and an honest conversation that chronic traumatic encephalopathy cannot be diagnosed during life. Guideline: National Institute of Neurological Disorders and Stroke Consensus Diagnostic Criteria for Traumatic Encephalopathy Syndrome (2021); CMID: Clinical Monitoring Intelligence Database, diabetes type 2, hypertension and hyperlipidemia monographs (2026) [S]

Cost and access: low-cost generics, 90-day supplies, and help with coverage for any brand-name medicine. Guideline: 1. Improving Care and Promoting Health in Populations: Standards of Care in Diabetes-2026 (2026) [S]
